package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func planningSnapshotProtectedFixture() (domain.StudentLearningPath, domain.LessonActivityFact, domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding) {
	sid := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	itemID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	reqID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	revision := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	pathID := "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	path := domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: pathID, StudentID: sid, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ID: itemID, Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemCompleted, FrozenRequirements: []domain.LessonRequirement{{ID: reqID, Type: "practice_completed", SourceReference: domain.LessonSourceReference{ID: revision, RevisionID: revision}, Satisfied: true}}}}}
	fact := domain.LessonActivityFact{StudentID: sid, ItemID: itemID, RequirementID: reqID, Type: "practice_completed", FactID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", OccurredAt: time.Now().UTC()}
	binding := domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{StudentID: sid, LearningPathID: pathID, LearningPathItemID: itemID, RequirementID: reqID, TaskRevisionID: revision, LearningPathPositionReservation: 0}
	return path, fact, binding
}
func TestPlanningSnapshotFactIsBoundToActualFrozenRequirement(t *testing.T) {
	p, f, _ := planningSnapshotProtectedFixture()
	got, e := planningSnapshotFactWithRequirement(p, f)
	if e != nil || got.SourceID != p.Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].SourceReference.ID || got.SourceRevisionID != p.Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].SourceReference.RevisionID {
		t.Fatalf("lost immutable fact provenance: %+v %v", got, e)
	}
	for _, change := range []func(*domain.LessonActivityFact){func(x *domain.LessonActivityFact) { x.StudentID = "foreign" }, func(x *domain.LessonActivityFact) { x.RequirementID = "foreign" }, func(x *domain.LessonActivityFact) { x.Type = "task_passed" }, func(x *domain.LessonActivityFact) { x.OccurredAt = time.Time{} }} {
		bad := f
		change(&bad)
		if _, e = planningSnapshotFactWithRequirement(p, bad); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrValidation) {
			t.Fatal("accepted missing/mismatched frozen fact binding")
		}
	}
	p.Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].Satisfied = false
	if _, e = planningSnapshotFactWithRequirement(p, f); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatal("accepted fact contradicting frozen requirement progress")
	}
}
func TestPlanningSnapshotPreservesPracticeAssociation(t *testing.T) {
	p, _, binding := planningSnapshotProtectedFixture()
	if !planningSnapshotPracticeBindingMatches(p, binding) {
		t.Fatal("valid completed association lost")
	}
	binding.TaskRevisionID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
	if planningSnapshotPracticeBindingMatches(p, binding) {
		t.Fatal("different Practice revision accepted")
	}
	binding.TaskRevisionID = p.Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].SourceReference.ID
	binding.LearningPathItemID = "foreign"
	if planningSnapshotPracticeBindingMatches(p, binding) {
		t.Fatal("foreign item association accepted")
	}
}
func TestPlanningSnapshotAdapterReadBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	raw, e := os.ReadFile("planning_snapshot_repo_pg.go")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	text := string(raw)
	for _, s := range []string{"pgx.RepeatableRead", "pgx.ReadOnly", "readPlanningSnapshotMastery", "readPlanningSnapshotEvidence", "readPlanningSnapshotFacts", "readPlanningSnapshotCourseBindings", "readPlanningSnapshotPracticeBindings", "transaction_timestamp()"} {
		if !strings.Contains(text, s) {
			t.Fatalf("missing owner read projection %s", s)
		}
	}
	// The sole LIMIT is a two-row intent cardinality guard. Histories remain complete.
	intentQuery := "FROM student_learning_intent WHERE student_id=$1 AND learning_path_id=$2 AND expected_path_revision=$3 AND consumed_at IS NULL ORDER BY intent_id LIMIT 2"
	if strings.Count(text, "LIMIT ") != 1 || !strings.Contains(text, intentQuery) {
		t.Fatal("intent guard missing or snapshot history truncated")
	}
	text = strings.Replace(text, intentQuery, "intent cardinality guard", 1)
	for _, s := range []string{"INSERT INTO", "DELETE FROM", "FOR UPDATE", "LIMIT ", "AnswerPayload", "workspace_digest", "lesson_content_json FROM", "frozen_task_json FROM", "http.NewRequest"} {
		if strings.Contains(text, s) {
			t.Fatalf("read projection contains forbidden or truncating operation %s", s)
		}
	}
	repo := (*LearningJourneyRepoPG)(nil)
	if _, e = repo.ReadPlanningSnapshot(context.Background(), "invalid", "invalid", nil); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing repository defaulted permissively")
	}
}

func TestPlanningSnapshotRetiredCancelledBindingDoesNotBlockCurrentPath(t *testing.T) {
	p, _, x := planningSnapshotProtectedFixture()
	x.LifecycleStatus = domain.PracticeLearningActionCancelled
	x.LearningPathItemID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	include, e := planningSnapshotCurrentPracticeBinding(p, x)
	if e != nil || include {
		t.Fatalf("detached CANCELLED history incorrectly blocks current path: include=%v err=%v", include, e)
	}
	x.LifecycleStatus = domain.PracticeLearningActionOpen
	if _, e = planningSnapshotCurrentPracticeBinding(p, x); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatal("dangling protected OPEN work silently omitted")
	}
	x.LifecycleStatus = domain.PracticeLearningActionReserved
	if _, e = planningSnapshotCurrentPracticeBinding(p, x); !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatal("dangling protected RESERVED work silently omitted")
	}
	x.LifecycleStatus = domain.PracticeLearningActionClosed
	x.LearningPathItemID = p.Items[0].ID
	if include, e = planningSnapshotCurrentPracticeBinding(p, x); e != nil || !include {
		t.Fatal("current completed binding association lost")
	}
}
